# Accent headline (`accent-headline`)

Headline with one serif-italic accent phrase.

Group: Foundations. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/foundations';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createAccentHeadline` (types in `dist/web/foundations/accentHeadline.d.ts`): `.mh-accent-headline--display | --headline | --title`: a heading in the sans face with one phrase, `.mh-accent-headline__accent`, in the serif face, italic and (by default) in the accent colour.

```ts
export function createAccentHeadline(options: AccentHeadlineOptions): AccentHeadlineHandle;

export interface AccentHeadlineOptions {
  /** The whole headline. */
  text: string;
  /** A phrase inside `text` set in serif italic; its first occurrence is used, or it is appended when absent. */
  accent?: string;
  size?: AccentHeadlineSize;
  /** Heading level; default 2. */
  level?: AccentHeadlineLevel;
  tone?: AccentHeadlineTone;
}

export interface AccentHeadlineHandle {
  el: HTMLHeadingElement;
  setText(text: string, accent?: string): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createAccentHeadline } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const partOfDay = (): string => {
  const hour = new Date().getHours();
  return hour < 12 ? 'morning' : hour < 18 ? 'afternoon' : 'evening';
};

const part = partOfDay();
const headline = createAccentHeadline({ text: `Good ${part}`, accent: part, size: 'display', level: 1 });

setInterval(() => {
  const now = partOfDay();
  headline.setText(`Good ${now}`, now);
}, 60_000);

document.body.append(headline.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { AccentHeadline } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

const partOfDay = (): string => {
  const hour = new Date().getHours();
  return hour < 12 ? 'morning' : hour < 18 ? 'afternoon' : 'evening';
};

export function AccentHeadlineExample() {
  const [part, setPart] = useState(partOfDay);
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setInterval(() => setPart(partOfDay()), 60_000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);
  return <AccentHeadline text={`Good ${part}`} accent={part} size="display" level={1} />;
}
```
